Dharma Productions and Dopamine Studios announced Kaaliya on Sunday, a Hindi monster thriller led by Kartik Aaryan. It reaches cinemas worldwide on Friday, 5 May 2028.

The first video opens with a mother telling her son about a monster called Kaaliya, before a giant creature attacks in the dark. The makers' announcement post reads: "Shri Krishna sent it away. We humans brought it back."

Sandeep Modi, known for the series The Night Manager and Aarya, directs; it is his first Hindi film for cinemas. Dopamine Studios, Kartik Aaryan's new production company, co-produces it with Karan Johar's Dharma Productions. Dopamine also backs Kabir Khan's Ladaku, due in cinemas in June 2027.
